## Tokens

## Constraints

### Must

- Use semantic color tokens from `src/styles/tokens.css`.
- Distinguish processing failures from legitimate missing-document outcomes.
- Keep operator actions explicit and provide actionable request errors.

### Avoid

- Hardcoded theme colors.
- Directional decorative borders.
- Automatically retrying failed claims without operator action.

## Decisions

- Completed sessions with claim read failures use a warning treatment and a `FAILED` status badge so operators cannot mistake partial technical failure for success.
- `REQUIRE_DOC` is reserved for claims whose detail page loaded successfully but had no downloadable files; navigation and rendering failures remain explicit errors.
